WORKING:
  - platforms/windows/ module: clipboard.rs, paste_handler.rs, overlay_manager.rs (stub), mod.rs
  - Windows clipboard: Win32 OpenClipboard/GetClipboardData/SetClipboardData via windows-sys
  - Paste simulation: Ctrl+V via enigo (no accessibility permission needed on Windows)
  - Keybind defaults: Ctrl+Shift+Space (push-to-talk), Ctrl+Shift+D (toggle), Ctrl+Shift+X (cancel)
  - Launch at login: Windows Registry HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run
  - Frontend: platform detection for modifier symbols and settings copy
  - whisper-rs: metal feature macOS-only, vulkan feature for Windows
  - Cargo.toml: windows-sys with clipboard/ui/registry features
BROKEN/STUB:
  - Overlay: returns error on Windows (non-fatal, app works without it)
  - FN key: doesn't exist on Windows, keybinds use Ctrl instead
COMMITS: bc800d3, 4ad5ede, da00708, acb5c45 (latest) on main
NEXT: Build natively on Windows (UTM ARM64, install Vulkan SDK + VS Build Tools + Rust + Node)
